name: Annaka (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Annaka city emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised mountain with a small arch.
history: Municipal flag of Annaka, a city in Gunma Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 2 November 2006.

features.role: Annaka city emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised mountain with a small arch
